text: Toveybeh-ye Sheykh Hatam ( Persian : ‎ , also Romanized as Ţoveybeh-ye Sheykh Ḩātam ; also known as Ţove'ībeh ) is a village in Jahad Rural District , Hamidiyeh District , Ahvaz County , Khuzestan Province , Iran . At the 2006 census , its population was 185 , in 41 families .
